summary: The right-click edit/spell-check context menu wired onto a text input.
description: A classic (pre-Lit) custom element that wraps a nested .textbox-input child and wires up its right-click context menu (undo/redo, cut/copy/paste/select-all, plus a real spell-check submenu when the spellcheck attribute is set), reading command state from the document's command dispatcher/controller. It is a standalone widget, not a base class the other moz-input-* elements extend; those are unrelated Lit components built on MozBaseInputElement (toolkit/content/widgets/lit-utils.mjs).

attributes.name: spellcheck
attributes.description: Whether the input is spell-checked; when true, the context menu includes the spell-check submenu (suggestions, add/undo add to dictionary, toggle, dictionary list) instead of the plain edit menu.

events.name: moz-input-box-rebuilt
events.description: Bubbling CustomEvent dispatched whenever the context menu is (re)built, i.e. on connect and whenever the spellcheck attribute changes.

methods.name: getMenuItem
methods.description: Returns the context-menu item with the given anonid.

methods.name: doCommand
methods.description: Looks up the command controller for a command id and runs it.
